wikitext: {{AnimeLocationInfobox |name=Avignon Town |characters=アブニヨンの町 |japanese=Avugnon Town |image=Avignon Town.png |imagesize=300px |region=Kalos |epicode=M17 |episode=Diancie and the Cocoon of Destruction }} '''Avignon Town''' (Japanese: '''アブニヨンの町''' ''Avugnon Town'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in [[Kalos]]. It is one of the settings of ''[[M17|Diancie and the Cocoon of Destruction]]''. It is overlooked by a large castle. {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} went to Avignon Town, where {{Ash}} lost a battle against [[Astrid]] in front of the castle. Meanwhile, {{an|Diancie}} had come to the town in search of {{OBP|Xerneas|M17}}. She was hunted down in the town's streets by [[Merilyn]] and [[Riot]], who wanted to capture her for her ability of creating diamonds. After Ash's battle, {{AP|Pikachu}} heard the noise of Merilyn and Riot attacking Diancie. Ash and Pikachu rushed to the site and jumped in front of Diancie to protect it from harm. While they distracted Merilyn and Riot, Diancie was able to escape with {{an|Clemont}}, {{an|Bonnie}}, and {{an|Serena}}. After spending some time with the group, Diancie was kidnapped by {{TRT}} and taken to a clock tower. Like Merilyn and Riot, they wanted to use Diancie to create diamonds for them. Diancie soon created so many diamonds that they flooded the clock tower. Diancie was then freed by [[Millis Steel]]. Diancie was reunited with Ash and his friends, and they promised her to help her on her quest to search for Xerneas. Following this, the group and Diancie left Avignon Town. ==In the manga== [[File:Avignon Town M17 manga.png|thumb|200px|Avignon Town in ''{{ma|Diancie and the Cocoon of Destruction}}'']] ===Movie adaptations=== Avignon Town appeared in ''{{ma|Diancie and the Cocoon of Destruction}}''. Unlike in the {{pkmn|movie}}, it was only shown during the battle between [[Ash's Hawlucha]] and [[Astrid]]'s {{p|Absol}}. {{-}} ==Trivia== ===Origin=== {{main|Pokémon world in relation to the real world#In the movies|Pokémon world in relation to the real world → In the movies}} The castle of Avignon Town may be modeled after the historical hotel of {{wp|Château Frontenac}} in {{wp|Quebec City}}, {{wp|Canada}}. Moreover, Director [[Kunihiko Yuyama]] and his team {{wp|Location scouting|scouted}} the Canadian cities of {{wp|Ottawa}} and {{wp|Toronto}}Location Scouting Report on the Pokémon movie website ([https://web.archive.org/web/20140625080318/http://www.pokemon-movie.jp/locahan_report/ archived]) (Japanese) ([https://dogasu.bulbagarden.net/movies/2014_xy_cocoon_destruction_diancie/xy_cocoon_destruction_diancie_location_scouting.html English translation by Dogasu]), where the team toured {{wp|Rideau Canal}} by the {{wp|Ottawa River}} where buildings built in {{wp|Châteauesque}} and {{wp|Gothic Revival}} architectural style such as {{wp|Château Laurier}} and the {{wp|Canadian Parliament Buildings}} on {{wp|Parliament Hill}} can be viewed from the canal. ==Names== {| class="roundtable" style="background:#{{colorschemedark|XY}}; border:3px solid #{{kalos color dark}}" |- ! style="background:#{{colorschemelight|XY}}" | Language ! style="background:#{{colorschemelight|XY}}" | Name ! style="background:#{{colorschemelight|XY}}" | Origin |- | Japanese | アブニヨンの町 ''Avugnon no Machi'' | From a corruption of アビニヨン ''{{wp|Avignon}}'' (a prefecture in southern France) |- | English | Avignon Town | From ''Avignon'' |} {{-}} ==References== {{reflist}} ==Related articles== {{M17 navbox}} {{Kalosanime}} {{DoubleProjectTag|Anime|Locations|locations in the animated series.}} [[Category:Movie locations]] [[Category:Towns]] [[es:Pueblo Avignon]] [[it:Avugnon Town]] [[zh:愛普尼優街]]
